basis.value_representation: Unmodified DuckDB CAST AS VARCHAR; SQL NULL is JSON null. Keys use the unchanged historical L0 normalization.

edits.old: cast(trim(both '"' from replace(list_extract(regexp_extract_all(record, '(^|,)("(?:[^"]|"")*"|\[[^\]]*\]|[^,]*)', 2), 59), '""', '"')) as VARCHAR) as interest_category
cast(trim(both '"' from replace(list_extract(regexp_extract_all(record, '(^|,)("(?:[^"]|"")*"|\[[^\]]*\]|[^,]*)', 2), 65), '""', '"')) as VARCHAR) as languages
try_cast(nullif(trim(trim(both '"' from replace(list_extract(regexp_extract_all(record, '(^|,)("(?:[^"]|"")*"|\[[^\]]*\]|[^,]*)', 2), 39), '""', '"'))), '') as DOUBLE) as budget
